1.0.3 documentation
  • Updated PreFormServer for PreForm release 3.65.0.
  • Export models as STL: /v1/scene/model/export/ is now available in public builds. Export a model you imported, for example to edit it in another program or to recover it from a .form file. Supports are not included in the export.
  • Move models between builds: /v1/scene/model/send-to-scene/ moves models from one scene to another, like Move to Build in PreForm.

1.0.0 documentation
  • Updated PreFormServer for PreForm release 3.64.0.
  • API V1.0 is officially released: Find more information about the API functionality on the API Reference page.
  • Translate no longer clamps to the build volume: /scene/model/translate/ no longer forces models back inside the build volume, matching PreForm, which allows models outside the build volume.
  • Crash saving with the "default" scene: Fixed PreForm Server crashing when saving an FPS file with the documented default scene alias.
